As for what happened that night, I was indeed hiding two little secrets.

The first thing was simple enough: I had the little fox keep an eye on the Express as it climbed into the sky, until it cleared the atmosphere and completed its warp. But as it turned out, that was completely unnecessary. Even if a meteor had fallen from the sky and slammed into it, the hand aiming at the Express from the other side of Arcadia would have cleared a path for it.
